_comment: Salesforce screens a learner has to click through. Captured by scripts/build/capture-salesforce.mjs over CDP, annotated by scripts/build/annotate.mjs. Nothing is ever saved in the org: a capture walks forward and leaves by navigating away.
_org_comment: Setup has to be in English, and that follows the user, not the URL: Salesforce ignores ?language= for a logged-in user. helios-dev holds the same Helios metadata but its only human user is French, so the captures are read from the UAT org, which carries the same objects, permission sets, rule and records.

lookups.crewPermSetId: SELECT Id FROM PermissionSet WHERE Name = 'Helios_Delivery_Crew' LIMIT 1
lookups.installationId: SELECT Id FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INST-00001' LIMIT 1
lookups.crewWarningFlowId: SELECT ActiveVersionId FROM FlowDefinitionView WHERE ApiName = 'Installation_Crew_Warning'
